install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/tabi-log
bash scripts/cloud/prepare.sh
start_skill:
Use the existing /workspace/tabi-log checkout. Cloud tasks are already isolated; do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested. Read AGENTS.md, docs/README.md, docs/development.md and docs/stage-one-status.md. Follow repository rules and work on a task branch. Human review and merge remain required.

Source /workspace/toolchains/tabi-log-env.sh in each shell. If missing or dependency pins changed, run bash /workspace/tabi-log/scripts/cloud/prepare.sh. This installs pinned Node with official SHA256 verification and pnpm, performs frozen install, generates native stories and installs hooks. Keep inherited proxy/CA settings and verification enabled. No app secrets are required. Do not print credentials.

From /workspace/tabi-log run pnpm check, pnpm build-storybook and pnpm check:native-bundles. The last command checks product and native Storybook source-map boundaries for Android/iOS; it does not execute native binaries.

Start only the services needed for the task in persistent execution sessions: pnpm storybook --host 127.0.0.1 for browser Storybook; pnpm start --offline --port 8081 --max-workers 2 for product Metro; pnpm storybook:native --offline --port 8082 --max-workers 2 for native Storybook Metro. Inspect occupied ports and do not stop unrelated processes. Verify responses and representative UI behavior. Snapshots do not retain running processes, so restart services when needed. Do not expose localhost preview links during onboarding.

Use docs/development.md for local Xcode/Android Studio and Development Build instructions. Android smoke checks require a dedicated emulator and APK; pnpm check:android-ui reinstalls/restarts dev.tabilog.app. This Linux cloud has no Xcode/iPhone or /dev/kvm. Do not claim device verification from JS exports. Check CI results and docs/stage-one-status.md before calling stage one complete.
